intention: Roshan listens, anticipates the boom, strikes the central lavender drum with her hand-held mallet and rebounds to a settled ready pose. The drum skin visibly responds.
required_action: Six coherent whole-frame drawings: ready, anticipation, downswing, genuine mallet-head contact/compression, rebound, settle. Body, shoulders, hair and tail counterbalance together.
fixed: Orthographic 3/4 front camera; constant kit fixtures and seat; mermaid has no legs or feet; same head/hand/arm sizes. Teal tom left, lavender playable central bass angled up toward mallet, star cymbal right. Seated tail has visible support.
entry_exit: Ready mallets held above kit, tail supported by low pearl seat. Settled exit returns ready without invented limb pieces.
reuse_gap: Inventoried existing drummer static reference and current atlas. Neither supplies a supported complete central drum strike. Reuse reference identity/kit; new full-frame keys fill only this named action.
method: Builtin ImageGen whole-frame key-sheet pilot, then local Aseprite timing/registration/export. Local sources cannot supply the missing seated strike/contact drawings; no paid API, separate limbs, deformation or still-frame campaign.
runtime: 6 equal 768px or larger cells in a 3x2 transparent native sheet; whole-frame master Aseprite RGBA; runtime each frame <=1024, original contours preserved; target actor ~440px tall.
